fusions.name: Recited Courses
fusions.desc: Speaks a measured line ahead of you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles in front, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Muddled] for 3 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up.

fusions.name: Last Letter Struck
fusions.desc: A strike at a target at or below 25% of its health that deals 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Corrected Script
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Lines
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
